description_en: Adds protected objects to a scenario-specific policy
description_zh: 为定制场景策略添加防护对象
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo attach-scene-defense-object --policy-id 321a-fd31-df51-0000 --object-type Domain --objects www.aliyun.com --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachSceneDefenseObject

parameters.help_en:
The policy ID.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159382.html to query all policy IDs
parameters.help_zh:
策略ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159382.html查询所有策略ID
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en: The object type. Set the value to Domain, which indicates a domain name
parameters.help_zh: 对象类型。取值：Domain，表示域名
parameters.name: object_type

parameters.help_en: The protected objects to add. Separate multiple objects with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 要添加的防护对象。多个对象间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: objects

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否成功调用。取值：
true：是
false：否
